Authors Profile
Dr. Muhammad Ibrahim
Dr. Muhammad Ibrahim is working in the Department of Elementary
and Secondary Education as Senior Subject Specialist in Chemistry, since
2003. He has obtained his Master degree in chemistry from University of
Peshawar. He got his Ph.D degree in education from Sarhad University of
Science & Information Technology, Peshawar. He has attended a number of
seminars and workshops on curriculum and textbook development. He is an
author of several articles, which have been published in national and
international journals.
Mushtaq-ur-Rehman
Mushtaq-ur-Rehman is working as lecturer in Chemistry Department
at Govt. College Shabqader, Charsadda. He got his M.Phil Degree in
Chemistry from N.C.E in Physical Chemistry from Peshawar University. He has
attended numerous seminars and workshops related to education and
development of Textbooks.
Dr. Fida Muhammad
Dr. Fida Muhammad did Ph.D in physical chemistry from university of
California. He worked as Associate Professor in Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute
for science and technology Swabi and N.C.E in Physical Chemistry Peshawar
University. His numerous research paper has been published. He has
extensive research experience in and outside the country. He worked as an
advisor in the development of Chemistry curriculum 2006 for grade IX and X.
Prof. Nawab Khan
Prof. Nawab Khan worked as Chairman BISE Malakand. He also served
as Subject Specialist (Science) in Textbook Board. He has got extensive
experience of textbooks writing and editing. He has got his master degree in
Chemistry from Peshawar University.

Mrs. Syeda Farheen
Mrs. Syeda Farheen got her M. Phil degree in chemistry from Quaid-
e-Azam University Islamabad. She attended various seminars and
workshops arranged by KPK Textbook Board for development of Text
books.
